[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Kornov''' was a former [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] as an assistant to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]].

==Biography==
After graduating from the [[Academy]] with honors and commendations, Kornov served a brief tour of duty as a starfighter pilot before being transferred to command school, where he excelled in his studies. After graduating from command school, Kornov was given command of a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]], which was later responsible for summarily crushing a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attack on an Imperial installation. Because of this, he received commendations and was assigned to Admiral Motti and the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] Project<ref name="DSTC-1" />

==Personality and traits==
Kornov was an idealistic young man who took pride in his uniform, and held a belief that the Rebellion against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was a shamelessly criminal act of unwarranted aggression. He inspired loyalty and hard work in his men and reflected this to his commanders. The epitome of an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]], Kornov was young, strong and handsome. He desired to serve the Empire to the best of his abilities, and he demanded the same of those who served under him.
